comparison_to_0954.state: Price UP + CVD UP + OI DOWN

reference_levels_visible.note: Reference-chart levels only; execution venue basis must be recalculated before orders.

interpretation: BTC extended sharply higher while CVD rose and OI fell. Large short liquidations relative to long liquidations indicate that a meaningful part of the impulse is short covering/forced short closure rather than fresh leveraged long accumulation. This is bullish price action and validates CASE-002 continuation, but it is less useful as a chase/add signal because the move is already being paid by a squeeze.

management.bullish_followthrough: Best continuation is price acceptance above the breakout/pDay-high area while OI stabilizes and CVD remains firm; falling OI while price holds high means leverage is being cleaned without losing price.
management.warning_1: If price stalls/fades after the squeeze while CVD rolls over, a reflex retrace becomes more likely even if OI is already lower.
management.warning_2: If OI starts rebuilding quickly after the squeeze but price no longer advances proportionally, crowding/buyer-efficiency risk returns.

lesson: Price UP + CVD UP + OI DOWN after a major reclaim often means squeeze/short deleveraging. It validates the direction but is a worse location to add than the earlier reclaim. Distinguish signal-generation from payoff: the edge was earlier; this is the payout phase.
